name: rss_reader
description: Read and parse RSS/Atom feeds. Returns latest entries with titles, links, and summaries.

manual.overview: Use rss_reader to follow news feeds, blogs, and content sources. RSS feeds provide structured updates from websites. Great for monitoring tech news, blog posts, and project updates.
tips: Many websites have RSS feeds at /feed, /rss, or /atom.xml.
Use limit to control how many entries to return.
Combine with web_search to read full articles from feed links.
edge_cases: Some feeds require authentication or may be behind a paywall.
Malformed XML feeds may fail to parse.
Not all websites offer RSS feeds.

executor.command: python -c "import urllib.request, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, json; data=urllib.request.urlopen('{{args.url}}', timeout=15).read(); root=ET.fromstring(data); ns={'a':'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}; items=root.findall('.//item') or root.findall('.//a:entry',ns); results=[{'title':(i.findtext('title') or i.findtext('a:title',namespaces=ns) or ''), 'link':(i.findtext('link') or (i.find('a:link',ns).get('href','') if i.find('a:link',ns) is not None else ''))} for i in items[:{{args.limit}}]]; print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))"
